title: Find the Deepest Left Leaf
problemStatement: Given the root of a binary tree, determine the deepest leaf that is a left child of its parent. If multiple such leaves exist at the same depth, return the leftmost one.
input: • The first line contains an integer N. • The next N lines describe the binary tree.
output: • Print the value of the deepest left leaf. If no left leaf exists, print NONE.
